title: Minister-led March 8 procession for traditional values
reason: No demand on the government by participants is documented. Kloop describes a procession led by the labor minister, announced by the Ministry of Labor, to express commitment to traditional values; it is not reported as a protest against state policy. Excluded on target criterion, not on size.
notes: Distinct from the women’s rights march E008 on the same date. S019 body lines 63-67; participant total unknown.
